prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn circuit_trace(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse threshold;events where threshold is a canonical positive decimal in 1..2147483647 and events contain only S or F. S resets consecutive failures. Reaching threshold failures opens the circuit; it then remains open. Return one C or O state per event, joined without separators.
Visible example: 2;FSFFS returns CCCOO.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

Required API: pub fn circuit_trace(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse threshold;events where threshold is a canonical positive decimal in 1..2147483647 and events contain only S or F. S resets consecutive failures. Reaching threshold failures opens the circuit; it then remains open. Return one C or O state per event, joined without separators.
Visible example: 2;FSFFS returns CCCOO.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: pub fn circuit_trace(input:&str)->Option<String>{let(n,e)=input.split_once(';')?;if n.is_empty()||n.starts_with('0')||!n.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_digit()){return None}let n:i32=n.parse().ok()?;if n<1{return None}let(mut f,mut open,mut o)=(0,false,String::new());for c in e.chars(){if c!='S'&&c!='F'{return None}if !open{if c=='S'{f=0}else{f+=1}open=f>=n}o.push(if open{'O'}else{'C'})}Some(o)}
